reasoning_content: The package name on Ubuntu 22.04 is `mapserver-bin` (7.6.4). Let's install mapserver-bin and libgdal32 (the package name on jammy is libgdal32, which should exist in jammy's universe... previously I got "Unable to locate" for libgdal32, but maybe it was because of the broken repo that was making apt-get update fail? apt update was also failing earlier because of the rabbitmq repo. Let's try installing again now.

action.command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get install -y -qq mapserver-bin libmapserver2 libgdal32 gdal-bin 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "exit=$?"; mapserver -buildinfo 2>&1 | head -6; gdalinfo --version
